title: Microsoft Teams: Awards and Certifications badges on profile cards
summary: The briefing needs one rollout correction: Microsoft's notice does not establish that Targeted Release happens before General Availability; both begin in early October. The badges' behaviour, Teams licensing requirement and beta deletion operations are supported.

claims.claim: No Microsoft 365 profile UI control is documented to remove an individual certification.

Read customize-profile-cards, personCertification and Delete personCertification; found source-system guidance and Graph, not a profile UI delete control.
